method_description: GenoPHI-inspired protein-family/CatBoost experiment with uniform reannotation; an explicit methodological adaptation, not exact replication of published proteomes
decision_context: Frozen after label-free annotation and CDS correspondence diagnostics, before feature clustering, model fitting or new target interaction scores. Ando labels were already known; study remains exploratory retrospective.
decision: Use the same pinned gene callers and commands for every retained training, validation and target genome; deposited example proteomes remain technical controls and are never mixed into feature inputs.
sequence_rules: Authenticate exact source bytes and bind source-to-phenotype mapping separately from protein prediction.
Retain original contig order and boundaries, all IUPAC DNA bases and their multiplicities; uppercase bases and replace only headers with unique neutral identifiers.

For phages use the deposited representation unchanged; only the exact-hash-reviewed T4LD leading empty-record exception is permitted by the normalizer. Do not trim the observed terminal60 overlap or infer circularity.
Keep raw caller .faa/.gff/logs; bind all actual tool, source and output hashes.

For later protein-feature inputs, remove exactly one terminal stop symbol per protein; preserve predicted start, length, copy count and internal amino-acid sequence. Reject internal stops or empty records; retain and count ambiguous X residues. Give all proteins globally unique neutral IDs.
training_isolation: Gene calling operates independently per genome, without infection labels or donor identity. Host single mode fits a within-genome coding model; phage meta mode uses the built-in distributed coding models.
Built-in coding-model training-genome overlap was not audited here. These are gene-calling models, not supervised infection predictors; do not claim generic pretraining independence.

Fit reference protein clusters, occurrence consolidation, feature selection, hyperparameters and any calibration using external training partitions only. Assign validation/target proteins to frozen training references.
Do not choose new annotation settings based on Ando infection results or transfer donor phenotypes.
remaining_before_fit: All host input files authenticated and target-near hosts excluded by frozen ANI policy
Final external training/validation memberships combining source-label mask and host/phage relatedness groups
Exact feature-clustering/assignment, feature-selection and CatBoost parameters, dependency versions, group splits and seeds frozen in a complete run manifest
Resource measurement for full feature preparation and modelling; no full-workflow estimate is inferred from the annotation pilot
interpretation: CDS correspondence supports using these deposited sequences as the declared representations for preprocessing, not experimental stock identity. Annotation choices do not establish adsorption, binding, assembly or functional infection.
